blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite the success of foundation models in image synthesis, achieving fine-grained spatial control remains a significant challenge, typically requiring auxiliary structural adapters or complex inference-time steering. While modern vision-language (VLM) text encoders possess the latent capacity to represent spatial coordinates, generative models often fail to leverage this information. We demonstrate that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) distribution is a critical determinant of spatial grounding in flow-matching models. Using a novel synthetic benchmark of geometric primitives, we isolate structural mechanics from textural complexity inherent in natural imagery and introduce a rigorous color-aware layout metric to quantify spatial fidelity. We show that training on a centered SNR distribution results in poor layout adherence (25.9%). Instead, we identify high-noise regimes as a "critical learning phase" for spatial grounding. Shifting the training focus toward these stages increases layout adherence to 80.8%, effectively reaching the 83.6% reconstruction ceiling of the underlying variational autoencoder. We find that the necessity for this shift scales with resolution and aspect ratio variance, and that the conservative noise schedules employed by models like FLUX.1 are insufficient for precise layout adherence. Finally, we show that these findings translate to real-world imagery via the COCO dataset (1.0 vs. 57.3 Average Precision), where state-of-the-art layout adherence is unlocked through distribution tuning alone, without architectural modifications.
blocks.zh: 尽管基础模型在图像合成上取得了成功,但实现精细的空间控制仍然是一个重大挑战,通常需要辅助结构适配器或复杂的推论时间引导. 虽然现代视觉语言(VLM)文本编码器具有代表空间坐标的潜在能力,但基因模型往往未能利用这些信息。 我们证明,信号与噪声比例(SNR)分布是流相匹配模型中空间定位的关键决定因素. 使用一款由几何原始物构成的新合成基准,将结构力学与自然影像所固有的纹理复杂性相分离,并引入了严格的色感布局度量法来量化空间忠心. 我们显示,关于中央SNR分配的培训导致布局守旧率低(25.9%)。 相反,我们将高噪声制度确定为空间地平面的"关键学习阶段". 将培训重点转向这些阶段,使布局坚持率提高到80.8%,实际上达到了基本变异自编码器的83.6%重建上限。 我们认为,这种具有分辨率和相比相差的转向尺度的必要性,以及FLUX.1等模型采用的保守噪声表不足以精确地坚持布局。 最后,我们通过COCO数据集(1.0对57.3平均精度)表明这些发现转化为了现实世界的图像,其中最先进的布局守口如瓶,仅通过分布调谐即可解锁,而不进行建筑改造.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The rapid evolution of diffusion [ Ho et al.(2020)Ho, Jain, and Abbeel , Song et al.(2021)Song, Sohl-Dickstein, Kingma, Kumar, Ermon, and Poole ] and flow-matching [ Lipman et al.(2023)Lipman, Chen, Ben-Hamu, Nickel, and Le , Liu et al.(2023)Liu, Gong, and qiang liu ] models is outpacing the adoption of these models for specialized use cases. In particular, while new state-of-the-art image synthesis models [ Wu et al.(2025a)Wu, Li, Zhou, Lin, Gao, Yan, ming Yin, Bai, Xu, Chen, Chen, Tang, Zhang, Wang, Yang, Yu, Cheng, Liu, Li, Zhang, Meng, Wei, Ni, Chen, Cao, Peng, Qu, Wu, Wang, Yu, Wen, Feng, Xu, Wang, Zhang, Zhu, Wu, Cai, and Liu , Team(2025) , Labs(2025) , Cao et al.(2025)Cao, Chen, Chen, Cheng, Cui, Deng, Dong, Gong, Gu, Gu, et al. ] are frequently released, achieving fine-grained spatial control over their outputs typically requires adopting one of two paradigms. The first involves training-based methods, which utilize auxiliary structural adapters such as ControlNet [ Zhang et al.(2023)Zhang, Rao, and Agrawala ] , GLIGEN [ Li et al.(2023)Li, Liu, Wu, Mu, Yang, Gao, Li, and Lee ] , or CreatiLayout [ Zhang et al.(2025)Zhang, Hong, Wang, Shao, Wu, Wu, and Jiang ] . The second relies on training-free methods, which steer the generation process of frozen backbones during inference to follow a target layout. However, adapters are often tightly coupled to specific model architectures, making them costly to retrain for each new release, while training-free methods often struggle with complex layouts or specific architectural constraints. This creates a critical need to understand why foundation models struggle to generate images that follow layouts from text alone.

blocks.en: Standard pre-trained models typically fail to interpret 2D coordinates embedded in text prompts, often treating them as non-spatial semantic tokens rather than geometric constraints. In contrast, recent advancements in vision-language models (VLMs), such as the Qwen-VL series [ Bai et al.(2025b)Bai, Chen, Liu, Wang, Ge, Song, Dang, Wang, Wang, Tang, Zhong, Zhu, Yang, Li, Wan, Wang, Ding, Fu, Xu, Ye, Zhang, Xie, Cheng, Zhang, Yang, Xu, and Lin , Bai et al.(2025a)Bai, Cai, Chen, Chen, Chen, Cheng, Deng, Ding, Gao, Ge, Ge, Guo, Huang, Huang, Huang, Hui, Jiang, Li, Li, Li, Li, Lin, Lin, Liu, Liu, Liu, Liu, Liu, Liu, Lu, Luo, Lv, Men, Meng, Ren, Ren, Song, Sun, Tang, Tu, Wan, Wang, Wang, Wang, Wang, Xie, Xu, Xu, Xu, Yang, Yang, Yang, Yang, Yu, Zhang, Zhang, Zhang, Zheng, Zhong, Zhou, Zhou, Zhou, Zhu, and Zhu ] , demonstrate that multimodal embeddings can successfully encode spatial relationships and discrete coordinates for tasks like object detection and grounding. This suggests that their multimodal embedding space already possesses the latent capacity to represent spatial information. As state-of-the-art text-to-image models increasingly adopt VLM-based text encoders, it remains an open question why the generative process fails to leverage this innate grounding capability. Therefore, we investigate whether, and under what conditions, text-to-image models can learn to follow explicit 2D layout specifications encoded solely in text prompts.
blocks.zh: 标准预先训练的模型通常无法解释嵌入在文本提示中的2D坐标,常常把它们当作非空间语义符号而不是几何限制. 相比之下,视觉语言模型(VLMs)最近的进步,如Quen-VL系列[Bai等人(2025b)Bai, 陈 刘 王爷 盖,宋, 可恶 王爷 王爷 汤 钟  Zhu 杨 丽 阿远 王爷 小叮当 发哥 许 叶,张, 谢 郑 张 杨 徐,和林,白等人(2025a) 裴,蔡, 编. 陈 陈 陈 郑 邓 小叮当 高 Gao 革,革,郭,黄,黄,胡. 蒋 丽 丽 丽 丽 莲 莲 刘 刘 刘 刘 刘 刘 鲁 罗,利夫,男人 孟g 连 连 歌声 孙 汤 阿图 阿远 王爷 王爷 王爷 王爷 谢 许 许 许,杨, 杨 杨 杨 项 张 张 张 郑 钟 周, 周, 周, Zhu, and Zhu],证明多式联运嵌入可以成功编码空间关系和离散坐标,用于物体检测和搁浅等任务. 这表明其多式联运嵌入空间已经具备代表空间信息的潜在能力。 由于最先进的文本到图像模型越来越多地采用基于VLM的文本编码器,因此基因过程为何未能利用这种固有地基能力仍然是一个未决问题。 因此,我们调查文本到图像模型是否能够和在何种条件下学会遵循仅用文本提示编码的明确的2D布局规格。

blocks.en: To this end, we examine the grounding capabilities of flow-matching models by fine-tuning them to interpret 2D coordinates directly from text prompts without introducing structural modifications. To isolate the mechanisms of spatial grounding, we first construct a controlled synthetic dataset of geometric primitives, enabling exact, pixel-level assessment of layout fidelity (Fig. 1 ). Our analysis reveals that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) distribution is the critical determinant of spatial grounding. We find that training on a balanced SNR distribution actually hinders the model from accurately learning coordinate-based constraints. Instead, biasing the training toward high-noise regimes, where global structure is established, allows the model to internalize the relationship between text tokens and spatial coordinates. Notably, we find that this distribution shift is necessary even at lower resolutions ( 256 2 256^{2} ), and that the conservative shifts employed by recent models like FLUX.1 [ Labs et al.(2025)Labs, Batifol, Blattmann, Boesel, Consul, Diagne, Dockhorn, English, English, Esser, Kulal, Lacey, Levi, Li, Lorenz, Müller, Podell, Rombach, Saini, Sauer, and Smith ] are insufficient for precise layout adherence. Finally, we demonstrate that these principles successfully translate to real-world imagery via the COCO dataset [ Lin et al.(2014)Lin, Maire, Belongie, Hays, Perona, Ramanan, Dollár, and Zitnick ] (Fig. 1 ), showing that state-of-the-art layout adherence can be unlocked in standard flow-matching models through distribution tuning alone, without the need for specialized architectural extensions.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们通过对流配对模型进行微调,在不引入结构修改的情况下,直接从文本提示中解析2D坐标,从而检查流配对模型的落地能力. 为了隔离空间搁浅机制,我们首先构建了几何原始的可控合成数据集,对布局的忠诚度进行了精确的像素级评估(图1)。 我们的分析表明,信号对噪音分布是空间地面的关键决定因素。 我们认为,关于平衡的SNR分配的培训实际上阻碍了模型准确学习基于协调的制约因素。 相反,如果将培训偏重于建立全球结构的高噪音制度,则该模式可以将文本符号和空间坐标之间的关系内部化。 值得注意的是,我们发现这种分配转移即使在较低的分辨率(256 2 256^{2})中也是必要的,而且最近一些模型,如FLUX.1[Labs et al.(2025)Labs、Batifol、Blatmann、Boesel、领事、Diagne、Dockhorn、英语、Essser、Kular、Lacey、Levi、Li、Lorenz、Müller、Podel、Rombach、Saini、Sauer和Smith]所使用的保守转移不足以准确的布局。 最后,我们通过COCO数据集(Lin等人(2014年),Lin,Maire,Onitualie,Hays,Perona,Ramanan,Dollar,和Zitnick)证明这些原则成功转化为现实世界的图像(图1),表明最先进的布局守法可以通过分配调节单独解锁在标准流配模型中,而不需要专门的建筑扩展.

blocks.en: Taken together, our results demonstrate that high-fidelity spatial control is a latent capability in state-of-the-art flow-matching models that can be unlocked by strategically shifting the SNR distribution during training, without requiring any architectural modifications. We show that the high-noise regime serves as a ”critical learning phase” for spatial grounding, forcing the model to internalize geometric constraints when global structure is not yet observable. Our main contributions are as follows: • Identification of SNR as a Key Facilitator: We provide a systematic study showing that biasing the SNR distribution toward high-noise regimes is essential for teaching models to interpret 2D coordinates embedded in text. • A Synthetic Benchmark for Spatial Precision: We introduce a benchmark consisting of geometric primitives that enables the exact, pixel-level quantification of layout adherence, isolating grounding mechanics from the textural complexities of real-world images. • Transfer to Real-World Imagery: We provide empirical evidence that these insights translate to complex real-world imagery via the COCO dataset, achieving state-of-the-art layout adherence in standard flow-matching models through distribution tuning alone, bypassing the need for specialized structural adapters.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的成果表明,高度真实性的空间控制是最新流配模型中的一种潜在能力,这种能力可以通过在培训期间战略性地改变SNR分布而解锁,而不需要任何建筑改造。 我们显示,高噪音制度是空间地面的“关键学习阶段”,迫使模型在全球结构尚未观察到时将几何限制内化。 • 确定国家情报局为主要调解人: 我们提供了一项系统研究,表明将SNR分布偏重于高噪声系统对于教学模型解释嵌入在文本中的2D坐标至关重要。 • 空间精度合成基准: 我们采用了一个由几何原始物组成的基准,能够精确、像素水平地量化布局的坚持性,将地面力学与现实世界图像的构造复杂性隔离开来。 • 向真实世界图像学转让: 我们提供了经验证据,证明这些见解通过COCO数据集转化为复杂的现实世界图像,通过分配单调实现标准流量匹配模型中最先进的布局坚持,绕过对专用结构适配器的需求.

blocks.en: Training Dynamics and SNR Schedules. The performance of flow-matching and diffusion models heavily depends on the timestep sampling distribution p ⁡ ( t ) p(t) , which determines the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) levels encountered during training [ Kingma and Gao(2023) , Esser et al.(2024)Esser, Kulal, Blattmann, Entezari, Müller, Saini, Levi, Lorenz, Sauer, Boesel, Podell, Dockhorn, English, and Rombach , Black Forest Labs(2025) ] . While logit-normal distributions are typically tuned to improve visual fidelity based on resolution [ Hoogeboom et al.(2023)Hoogeboom, Heek, and Salimans , Labs et al.(2025)Labs, Batifol, Blattmann, Boesel, Consul, Diagne, Dockhorn, English, English, Esser, Kulal, Lacey, Levi, Li, Lorenz, Müller, Podell, Rombach, Saini, Sauer, and Smith , Esser et al.(2024)Esser, Kulal, Blattmann, Entezari, Müller, Saini, Levi, Lorenz, Sauer, Boesel, Podell, Dockhorn, English, and Rombach ] or dimensionality [ Zheng et al.(2026)Zheng, Ma, Tong, and Xie ] , their impact on spatial grounding is only beginning to be examined. Recent work by Wu et al [ Wu et al.(2025b)Wu, Chen, Liang, Wang, Li, Zhang, Wang, and Yuan ] and Zhang et al [ Zhang et al.(2025)Zhang, Hong, Wang, Shao, Wu, Wu, and Jiang ] provides evidence that noise schedules influence layout adherence. However, their findings are coupled with specialized regional or siamese architectures. In contrast, our work demonstrates that the SNR distribution alone serves as the primary lever for internalizing spatial-semantic mappings in standard, structurally unmodified flow-matching models. We show that the acquisition of spatial grounding from text prompts alone is highly sensitive to p ⁡ ( t ) p(t) , revealing that high-noise regimes represent the essential window for anchoring textual coordinates to global structural composition.

blocks.en: Layout-to-Image (L2I) Generation. Layout-to-image approaches address the limitations of native spatial control by augmenting pre-trained synthesis models with explicit geometric conditioning (e.g., bounding boxes or masks). This is increasingly viewed as a multi-stage pipeline, beginning with upstream planning where Large Language Models (LLMs) or autoregressive VLMs translate linguistic descriptions into structural layouts [ Wang et al.(2025)Wang, Cao, Ding, Xie, Gu, and Chen , He et al.(2025)He, Cheng, Ma, Jia, Liu, Ma, Wu, Wu, Leng, and Yin , Feng et al.(2024b)Feng, Gong, Chen, Shen, Liu, and Zhou ] . Other approaches bridge the gap between text and pixels by synthesizing intermediate representations, such as depth maps, to guide the final generative process [ Zhou et al.(2025b)Zhou, Xie, Yang, and Yang , Zhou et al.(2025a)Zhou, Xie, Yang, and Yang , Eldesokey and Wonka(2025) ] . Once a spatial structure is established, the literature diverges into training-based and training-free strategies. Training-based L2I methods adapt model architectures to interpret spatial signals via fine-tuning or dedicated adapters [ Li et al.(2023)Li, Liu, Wu, Mu, Yang, Gao, Li, and Lee , Zheng et al.(2023)Zheng, Zhou, Li, Qi, Shan, and Li , Yang et al.(2023)Yang, Luo, Chen, Wang, Liang, and Lin ] . These works have evolved to handle multi-instance scenarios by using spatial attention disentanglement [ Zhou et al.(2024)Zhou, Li, Ma, Zhang, and Yang , Wang et al.(2024)Wang, Darrell, Rambhatla, Girdhar, and Misra ] or hierarchical composition [ Cheng et al.(2024)Cheng, Ma, Wu, Liu, Ma, Wu, Leng, and Yin ] to minimize attribute leakage. Beyond image quality, these models often serve as data engines to synthesize paired training data for perception tasks [ Feng et al.(2024a)Feng, Zhong, Jie, Xie, and Ma , Zhu et al.(2024)Zhu, Li, Liu, Yuan, Huang, Shan, and Ma ] . Recently, MMDiT architectures have been enhanced with siamese attention to isolate layout signals [ Zhang et al.(2025)Zhang, Hong, Wang, Shao, Wu, Wu, and Jiang ] and hybrid control frameworks to achieve data-efficient grounding [ Wu et al.(2025b)Wu, Chen, Liang, Wang, Li, Zhang, Wang, and Yuan ] . To avoid the high cost of retraining, training-free L2I methods intervene in the sampling process of frozen backbones. These strategies primarily manipulate internal cross-attention maps to ensure semantic isolation of subjects [ Xue et al.(2023)Xue, Huang, Sun, Song, and Zhang , Dahary et al.(2025)Dahary, Patashnik, Aberman, and Cohen-Or , Zhan and Liu(2025) ] or employ optimization-based guidance to steer the denoising trajectory toward specified coordinates [ Chen et al.(2024)Chen, Laina, and Vedaldi , Phung et al.(2024)Phung, Ge, and Huang , Xiao et al.(2024)Xiao, Lv, Li, Wang, and Huang , Liu et al.(2025)Liu, Huang, and Xu , Li et al.(2025)Li, Hu, Liu, and Wang ] . Beyond attention manipulation, compositional strategies decentralize the process by merging localized per-object noise estimates or synchronizing global and instance-specific denoising branches [ Shirakawa and Uchida(2024) , Lee et al.(2024)Lee, Yoon, and Sung ] . Finally, probabilistic approaches like Psi-Sampler [ Yoon et al.(2026)Yoon, Min, Yeo, and Sung ] reinterpret layout adherence as an inference-time reward alignment problem, using Sequential Monte Carlo sampling to filter trajectories.
blocks.zh: 布局对图像(L2I)生成. 从布局到图像的方法通过增加预先训练的合成模型,加上明确的几何条件(例如边框或口罩)来解决本土空间控制的局限性. 这日益被视为一个多阶段的管道,从上游规划开始,即大语言模型(LLM)或自递式VLM将语言描述转化为结构布局[Wang等人(2025年)Wang, 曹操,曹操 小叮当 谢 顾,和陈,贺等人(2025)贺,程, 妈 贾 刘 妈 吴,吴,冷,和殷,冯等(2024b) 冯, 阿刚 陈 沈,刘,和周]. 其他方法通过合成中间代表物如深度图来弥合文本和像素之间的差距,以指导最终的基因过程[周等人(2025年b)周,谢,谢. 杨,和,周等人(2025年a) 周,谢,. 杨,和,埃尔德索基和元卡(2025)]. 一旦建立了空间结构,文献就转向基于培训和无培训的战略。 基于培训的L2I方法改造模型架构,通过微调或专用适配器解释空间信号[李等人(2023)Li,刘, 吴 缪 杨,高,李,和 李,郑等人(2023年) 曾, 周, 丽 齐,山,和李,杨等(2023年) 杨,罗. 陈 王, 梁, 和林)]. 这些作品通过使用空间注意力分解(英语:Space attention)而演化为处理多事件情景[周 al等(2024)周hou,. 丽 马,张,杨等,王等(2024年) 汪,达雷尔,兰布哈特拉,吉尔达尔,和米斯拉]或等级构成[程等(2024年) 谢ng, 妈 吴,刘 妈 吴,冷,和殷]]尽量减少属性渗漏. 除了图像质量外,这些模型还经常作为数据引擎,用于合成配对的训练数据,以完成感知任务[冯等人(2024a) 冯,钟,杰,谢,和马,朱等人(2024) Zhu, 李,刘 袁,黄,山,马]. 最近,MMDiT架构得到增强,对隔离布局信号的暹罗关注[张等(2025)张, 阿红 王爷 绍 Wu, Wu, and Jiang)和混合控制框架,以实现数据高效的地基定位[Wu等人(2025b) 吴,陈, 梁, 王爷 丽 张 王,和元] (中文(简体) ). 为了避免再培训的高成本,无培训的L2I方法干预冷冻骨干取样过程. 这些战略主要操纵内部交叉观察地图,以确保对主体进行语义隔离[薛等人(2023年) 薛、黄、孙、宋和张、达哈里等人(2025年) Dahary、Patashnik、Aberman、Cohen-Or、Zhan和Liu(2025年)],或采用基于优化的指南,引导去诺轨道朝特定坐标方向行进[陈等人(2024年)Chen、Laina、Vedaldi、Phung等人(2024年)Phung、Ge和黄、Xiao等人(2024年)Xiao、Lv、Li、Lang和Huel等人(2025年)Liu、Hu和Xu等人(2025年)Li, 胡,刘,和汪]. 除了注意力操纵之外,组成策略通过将局部的每个物体噪声估计或同步全球和特定实例的去诺分枝(白川(2024),李等人(2024)Lee,尹和成)来分散这一过程. 最后,Psi-Sampler等概率主义方法[Yoon等人(2026年)Yoon,Min, Yeo, and Sung]重新诠释了布局守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守守

blocks.en: While existing L2I methods typically rely on external modules to bypass spatial reasoning limitations, this study investigates a more fundamental question: can flow-matching models acquire spatial grounding from text prompts alone, without any structural modifications?
blocks.zh: 虽然现有的L2I方法通常依赖外部模块来绕过空间推理限制,但本研究调查了一个更根本性的问题:流比模型能否仅从文本提示获得空间地面,而无需任何结构修改?

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Synthetic Benchmark for Text-Layout Image Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 文本-Layout图像生成合成基准

blocks.en: To facilitate training and provide a controlled environment for evaluation, we construct a synthetic dataset comprising 100,000 training pairs. For rigorous quantitative evaluation, we hold out a curated benchmark set of 1,000 text-image pairs. Images are rendered at resolution W × H W\times H and contain n ∼ 𝒰 ​ { 1 , 10 } n\sim\mathcal{U}\{1,10\} rectangles. In our standard benchmark, we set W = H = 256 W=H=256 . Notably, our generation pipeline is agnostic to resolution and aspect ratio, enabling us to evaluate scalability across higher resolutions (e.g., 1024 2 1024^{2} ) and varying aspect ratios, as detailed in Section 4.2 . By utilizing simple geometric primitives, this approach mitigates the textural complexity and photometric noise present in real-world images. This simplification enables us to disentangle spatial control from semantic rendering, allowing for a systematic and quantitative evaluation of a model’s geometric layout compliance.
blocks.zh: 为了便利培训和为评价提供一个有控制的环境,我们构建了一个由100 000对培训组合组成的合成数据集。 为了进行严格的定量评估,我们制定了一套由1 000个文本图像组合组成的全面基准。 图像在分辨率 W × H W\times H 中渲染,并包含 n\ U { 1, 10} n\sim\ mathcal{ U\\\ 1, 10} 矩形 。 在我们的标准基准中,我们设定了W=H=256W=H=256. 值得注意的是,我们这一代的管道对分辨率和侧面比率是不可知的,使我们能够评估高分辨率的可伸缩性(如1024 2 1024^{2})和不同侧面比率,详见第4.2节。 通过使用简单的几何原始,这种方法减轻了现实世界影像中存在的纹理复杂性和光度噪声. 这种简化使我们能够将空间控制从语义渲染中分离出来,从而能够对模型的几何布局遵守情况进行系统和定量的评价。

blocks.en: Layout Synthesis. We adopt rectangles as spatial primitives to mirror standard bounding-box formats and enable precise evaluation. To facilitate a systematic study of spatial grounding, we sample geometric properties from an extensive distribution that spans diverse scales and aspect ratios. Specifically, we define aspect ratio r r and area A A through log-uniform sampling: ln ⁡ ( r ) ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( ln ⁡ 1 20 , ln ⁡ 20 ) \ln(r)\sim\mathcal{U}(\ln\frac{1}{20},\ln 20) and ln ⁡ ( A ) ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( ln ⁡ A m ​ i ​ n , ln ⁡ A m ​ a ​ x ) \ln(A)\sim\mathcal{U}(\ln A_{min},\ln A_{max}) , where A m ​ i ​ n = 0.05 ​ W × 0.05 ​ H A_{min}=0.05W\times 0.05H and A m ​ a ​ x = 0.9 ​ W × 0.9 ​ H A_{max}=0.9W\times 0.9H . Dimensions are then derived as w = A ⋅ r w=\sqrt{A\cdot r} and h = A / r h=\sqrt{A/r} . This diverse geometric sampling ensures the benchmark provides a robust evaluation of spatial control, testing the model’s ability to generalize across a wide range of object shapes.

blocks.en: Scene Composition. We sample centers ( c x , c y ) (c_{x},c_{y}) uniformly and clip the resulting rectangles to the image frame [ 0 , W ] × [ 0 , H ] [0,W]\times[0,H] . As rectangles are rendered sequentially, we remove fully obscured rectangles from the metadata and prompt to ensure semantic consistency. This guarantees that all described objects are at least partially visible, preventing a mismatch between the textual description and visual ground truth.
blocks.zh: 场景构成. 我们取样中心(c x, c y) (c_{x}, c_{y}) 统一并剪接由此形成的矩形到图像框 [0, W] × [0, H] [0, W]\times [0, H]. 由于矩形依次变形,我们从元数据中删除了完全模糊的矩形,并迅速确保语义的一致性. 这保证了所有描述的对象至少是部分可见的,防止了文字描述和视觉地面真理之间的不匹配.

blocks.en: Semantic Mapping. Each rectangle is assigned a unique color from a fixed palette of ten distinct values. To ensure maximum discriminability, which is important for our layout adherence metric introduced in Section 3.2 , these colors are selected to be maximally distant from one another in the CIELAB color space. Each color is mapped to its corresponding linguistic label using the XKCD color naming convention [ Munroe(2010) ] (e.g., fluro green).

blocks.en: Fine-Tuning. While our primary experiments utilize FLUX.2-4B-base, we also scale our approach to larger models including FLUX.2-9B-base [ Labs(2025) ] , FLUX.1-dev (12B) [ Labs et al.(2025)Labs, Batifol, Blattmann, Boesel, Consul, Diagne, Dockhorn, English, English, Esser, Kulal, Lacey, Levi, Li, Lorenz, Müller, Podell, Rombach, Saini, Sauer, and Smith , Labs(2024) ] , and Qwen-Image (20B) [ Wu et al.(2025a)Wu, Li, Zhou, Lin, Gao, Yan, ming Yin, Bai, Xu, Chen, Chen, Tang, Zhang, Wang, Yang, Yu, Cheng, Liu, Li, Zhang, Meng, Wei, Ni, Chen, Cao, Peng, Qu, Wu, Wang, Yu, Wen, Feng, Xu, Wang, Zhang, Zhu, Wu, Cai, and Liu ] . To enable fine-tuning on a single 80GB A100 GPU, we utilize the Adafactor optimizer [ Shazeer and Stern(2018) ] (with constant scale, disabling relative step and parameter scaling) alongside a fused backward pass and gradient checkpointing. This configuration, combined with BFloat16 precision, reduces the peak memory footprint of the 20B Qwen-Image model from 160GB to 44GB at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution. We fine-tune for 100,000 steps using a unit batch size, as layer-wise fused updates are mathematically incompatible with gradient accumulation. This approach leverages recent findings that small-batch training maintains competitive convergence and generalization for large generative models [ Marek et al.(2026)Marek, Lotfi, Somasundaram, Wilson, and Goldblum ] . To ensure training stability and preserve generation fidelity, we employ an EMA model (0.9995 decay, γ = 10 \gamma=10 Karras schedule [ Karras et al.(2024)Karras, Aittala, Lehtinen, Hellsten, Aila, and Laine ] ) and a cosine learning rate schedule ( 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} to 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} ) following a 5,000-step warmup. Finally, 10% of prompts are nullified for classifier-free guidance (CFG).

Fig. 6 shows that lower values ( μ ≤ 0.5 \mu\leq 0.5 ) result in perceivable structural misalignments. While increasing μ \mu to 3.0 yields visually stable layouts, we observe a quantitative performance degradation in mIoU 2 : 25 \mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} (Tab. 2 , Fig. 5 ). Our analysis (see Appendix A ) reveals that this drop stems not from structural failure, but from a loss of pixel-level color precision. At this extreme, the model’s color assignments frequently fall just outside color-matching threshold τ \tau , despite correct spatial placement. This observation highlights a fundamental trade-off in the μ \mu -shifting schedule: while a high μ \mu prioritizes global structural grounding, it may limit the model’s capacity to resolve high-frequency components. In the context of natural images, this would manifest as a loss of fine-grained textural details. Importantly, moderate shifts ( μ ∈ [ 1.0 , 2.5 ] \mu\in[1.0,2.5] ) nearly reach the VAE reconstruction upper bound of 83.6. These results suggest that vanilla flow-matching architectures possess the latent capacity to internalize coordinate-based constraints directly from text prompts. Within our controlled synthetic environment, the model achieves near-optimal layout adherence through distribution shifting alone, demonstrating the architectural feasibility of precise spatial grounding without auxiliary modules or inference-time interventions.

For resolution experiments, we re-render our image data at 512 2 512^{2} and 1024 2 1024^{2} while keeping all geometric and textual properties fixed, isolating the effect of resolution from layout complexity. For aspect ratio experiments, we derive resolution buckets ( w , h ) (w,h) from a fixed area A = 256 2 A=256^{2} such that w ⋅ h ≈ A w\cdot h\approx A , where w w and h h are multiples of 16. We include all pairs satisfying max ⁡ ( w , h ) min ⁡ ( w , h ) ≤ r max \frac{\max(w,h)}{\min(w,h)}\leq r_{\mathrm{max}} , ensuring portrait-landscape symmetry. Following prior work [ Hoogeboom et al.(2023)Hoogeboom, Heek, and Salimans , Esser et al.(2024)Esser, Kulal, Blattmann, Entezari, Müller, Saini, Levi, Lorenz, Sauer, Boesel, Podell, Dockhorn, English, and Rombach , Labs et al.(2025)Labs, Batifol, Blattmann, Boesel, Consul, Diagne, Dockhorn, English, English, Esser, Kulal, Lacey, Levi, Li, Lorenz, Müller, Podell, Rombach, Saini, Sauer, and Smith ] suggesting that higher resolutions require increased timestep shifting for optimal image quality, we use the optimal μ \mu from the previous configuration as a lower bound for subsequent searches. For instance, having found μ = 1 \mu=1 optimal for 256 2 256^{2} , we limit our search to μ ∈ [ 1 , 3 ] \mu\in[1,3] for the 512 2 512^{2} scale. By applying this strategy, we can substantially reduce the search space compared to a full μ \mu -sweep for each setting. blocks.en: Resolution. Table 2 summarizes the impact of the logit-normal shift μ \mu on layout adherence as resolution increases. We observe a clear trend: the optimal μ \mu value is positively correlated with the image resolution. For the 256 2 256^{2} base resolution, a moderate shift of μ = 1.0 \mu=1.0 yields the highest performance ( 80.8 mIoU 2 : 25 80.8~\mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} ), nearly saturating the VAE reconstruction bound of 83.6 83.6 . However, this configuration fails to generalize to higher resolutions. At 512 2 512^{2} , μ = 1.0 \mu=1.0 results in a significant drop in layout adherence ( 48.1 mIoU 2 : 25 48.1~\mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} ). Instead, higher resolutions require a more aggressive shift toward earlier timesteps (higher noise levels) to maintain spatial control. Specifically, peak performance shifts to μ = 2.0 \mu=2.0 for 512 2 512^{2} and μ = 2.5 \mu=2.5 for 1024 2 1024^{2} . Notably, with the appropriately tuned μ \mu , our model maintains high layout adherence across all scales, reaching 82.7 mIoU 2 : 25 82.7~\mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} at 1024 2 1024^{2} , approaching the VAE’s empirical ceiling. This suggests that as the resolution increases, a stronger prior on the early denoising phase is essential for the acquisition of spatial grounding from text prompts alone.

Aspect Ratio. We further evaluate the impact of μ \mu across varying aspect ratios ( r max r_{\mathrm{max}} ), as shown in Tab. 2 . Consistent with the resolution experiments, we find that the base configuration ( μ = 1.0 \mu=1.0 ) is insufficient for handling non-square geometries, with performance dropping from 80.8 80.8 to 67.8 mIoU 2 : 25 67.8~\mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} when moving from r max = 1 r_{\mathrm{max}}=1 to r max = 2 r_{\mathrm{max}}=2 . By increasing μ \mu to the 2.0 ​ – ​ 2.5 2.0\text{--}2.5 range, the model recovers strong layout adherence even for extreme aspect ratios ( r max = 3 r_{\mathrm{max}}=3 ). While there is a slight decrease in absolute mIoU 2 : 25 \mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} as the aspect ratio becomes more extreme (likely due to the increased difficulty of placing objects in narrow or highly elongated canvases), the shift in μ \mu effectively mitigates the drop in spatial control seen with centered timestep distributions. These results demonstrate that the relationship between the timestep distribution p ⁡ ( t ) p(t) and spatial grounding is not static, but rather highly sensitive to the geometric complexity of the output space. Collectively, these findings indicate that spatial grounding is heavily dependent on the noise levels encountered during training, necessitating a higher noise prior as image resolution and aspect ratios increase.

blocks.en: 4.3 Architectural Generalization
blocks.zh: 4.3 建筑概况

blocks.en: To assess if the relationship between spatial grounding and SNR distribution shift (parameterized by μ \mu ) generalizes across different architectural configurations and text-conditioning strategies, we extend our evaluation to three larger-scale models: FLUX.2-9B-base [ Labs(2025) ] and Qwen-Image (20B) [ Wu et al.(2025a)Wu, Li, Zhou, Lin, Gao, Yan, ming Yin, Bai, Xu, Chen, Chen, Tang, Zhang, Wang, Yang, Yu, Cheng, Liu, Li, Zhang, Meng, Wei, Ni, Chen, Cao, Peng, Qu, Wu, Wang, Yu, Wen, Feng, Xu, Wang, Zhang, Zhu, Wu, Cai, and Liu ] , which both utilize a pre-aligned Vision-Language Model (VLM) encoder, and FLUX.1-dev (12B) [ Labs et al.(2025)Labs, Batifol, Blattmann, Boesel, Consul, Diagne, Dockhorn, English, English, Esser, Kulal, Lacey, Levi, Li, Lorenz, Müller, Podell, Rombach, Saini, Sauer, and Smith , Labs(2024) ] , which employs a dual-encoder setup consisting of CLIP-L [ Radford et al.(2021)Radford, Kim, Hallacy, Ramesh, Goh, Agarwal, Sastry, Askell, Mishkin, Clark, Krueger, and Sutskever ] and T5-XXL [ Raffel et al.(2020)Raffel, Shazeer, Roberts, Lee, Narang, Matena, Zhou, Li, and Liu ] . Since these models utilize different VAE architectures with varying reconstruction fidelities, we measure performance relative to their respective VAE upper bounds. We use μ = 1.0 \mu=1.0 , the optimal shift identified in Section 4.2 for square images at 256 2 256^{2} resolution, as a common starting point across architectures and compare it against a centered SNR distribution ( μ = 0.0 \mu=0.0 ) as a baseline.

blocks.en: Generalization Across Architectures. The results in Tab. 3 demonstrate that shifting the timestep sampling distribution is a generalizable mechanism to unlock spatial grounding in flow-matching models using text prompts only. This effect remains consistent regardless of the specific transformer backbone or text-conditioning strategy. While our primary experiments use the FLUX.2-4B-base architecture, the ability to recover layout adherence in 9B, 12B, and 20B models by tuning the SNR shift suggests a fundamental property of how flow-matching models interpret spatial instructions across scales.
blocks.zh: 通论跨建筑. Tab. 3的结果显示,改变时间步采样分布是一种通用机制,仅使用文本提示解锁流匹配模型中的空间定位。 无论具体的变压器主干线或文本调节策略如何,这种效果始终如一. 虽然我们的主要实验使用FLUX.2-4B基架构,但通过调制SNR移来恢复9B,12B和20B模型的布局守恒的能力,表明流配模型如何解释跨尺度空间指令的基本属性.

blocks.en: Impact of Text Conditioning. We observe a clear correlation between the choice of text encoder and the model’s sensitivity to the shifting parameter μ \mu . At μ = 1.0 \mu=1.0 , models using Vision-Language Model (VLM) encoders, such as Qwen-Image and FLUX.2, demonstrate high layout adherence ( ≥ 80.8 mIoU 2 : 25 \geq 80.8~\mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} ). In contrast, FLUX.1-dev (using T5 and CLIP) requires a significantly stronger shift ( μ = 3.0 \mu=3.0 ) to achieve comparable grounding performance. This suggests that VLM-based conditioning provides a more integrated spatial-semantic representation that is inherently more ”accessible” to the denoising process than the separately trained embeddings provided by T5 and CLIP encoders.
blocks.zh: 文本条件的影响。 我们观察到文本编码器的选择与模型对移动参数μ\mu的敏感度之间有明显的关联. 在 μ = 1.0\mu = 1. 0 时,使用 Vision-Langage model(VLM)编码器的模型,如 Quen-Image 和 FLUX 2 , 显示出高度的布局坚持度( ^ 80.8 mIoU 2 : 25\geq 80.8\ mathrm{ mIoU → 2: 25}). 相比之下,FLUX.1-dev(使用T5和CLIP)则需要显著的更强的转变(μ = 3.0\mu = 3.0),以实现可比的地基性能. 这表明,基于VLM的调制提供了一种更为综合的空间语义表述,与T5和CLIP编码器提供的单独训练的嵌入相比,这种调制过程在本质上更“容易获得”。

blocks.en: Generative Gap and VAE Learnability. While all four models achieve high mIoU 2 : 25 \mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} scores, their ”generative gaps” ( Δ \Delta ) reveal a fundamental trade-off between VAE reconstruction fidelity and latent-space learnability. The FLUX.2 VAE is specifically optimized for representation learnability [ Black Forest Labs(2025) ] , which is reflected in the remarkably small gaps of 2.8 (FLUX.2-4B-base) and 2.1 (FLUX.2-9B-base), indicating that the FLUX.2 models can almost fully exploit the empirical VAE reconstruction limit. However, this optimization for learnability entails a trade-off in reconstruction precision (e.g., color fidelity), leading to a lower VAE upper bound compared to Qwen-Image or FLUX.1-dev. Conversely, while the latter models possess higher reconstruction ceilings, their latent spaces appear significantly harder to navigate for precise spatial grounding, as evidenced by their larger generative gaps. This suggests that recent advancements in improving VAE learnability [ Zheng et al.(2026)Zheng, Ma, Tong, and Xie , Black Forest Labs(2025) ] not only benefit image quality but also play a critical role in a model’s ability to adhere to complex layout instructions from text prompts.
blocks.zh: 基因差距和VAE学习能力。 虽然这四个模型都实现了高 mIoU 2 : 25\ mathrm{ mIoU\\ 2: 25} 分数,但是它们的“基因差距”(\\ \ Delta) 揭示了VAE重建忠心度与潜在空间可学习性之间的根本权衡. FLUX.2 VAE特别优化了表现学习能力[黑森林实验室(2025)],这体现在2.8(FLUX.2-4B-基)和2.1(FLUX.2-9B-基)的显著小差距上,表明FLUX.2模型几乎能够充分利用经验性的VAE重建极限. 然而,这种对可学习性的优化需要在重建精度(如颜色忠贞)上进行权衡,导致与Quen-Image或FLUX.1-dev相比,VAE上限较低. 反之,虽然后一种模型的重建上限较高,但其潜在的空间似乎更难精确地进行空间定位,其较大基因差异就证明了这一点。 这表明最近在提高VAE的可学习性方面有所进步[郑等人(2026年),Zheng, 妈 Tong, and Xie, Black Forest Labs(2025)))不仅有利于图像质量,而且对模型遵守文本提示的复杂布局指示的能力起着关键作用.

blocks.en: 5 Real-World Images
blocks.zh: 5 真实世界图像

blocks.en: In the previous section, we established that flow-matching models can acquire strong layout adherence through text prompts alone by optimizing the SNR distribution. While our synthetic benchmark allowed for a controlled mechanistic study, we now investigate whether these findings transfer to the semantically rich domain of real-world images.
blocks.zh: 在上一节中,我们确定,流配模型可以通过优化SNR分布,仅通过文字提示就获得强烈的布局坚持性. 虽然我们的合成基准允许进行受控制的机械学研究,但我们现在调查这些结果是否转移到真实世界图像的丰富领域。

blocks.en: Dataset and Evaluation. Following standardized protocols [ Zhang et al.(2025)Zhang, Hong, Wang, Shao, Wu, Wu, and Jiang , Yang et al.(2023)Yang, Luo, Chen, Wang, Liang, and Lin , Li et al.(2023)Li, Liu, Wu, Mu, Yang, Gao, Li, and Lee ] , we evaluate on MS-COCO 2017 [ Lin et al.(2014)Lin, Maire, Belongie, Hays, Perona, Ramanan, Dollár, and Zitnick ] , excluding images with crowds, dense clusters, or objects smaller than 2% of the canvas. This yields 61,986 training and 2,565 validation images. We assess layout adherence using a frozen YOLO-v11-x [ Khanam and Hussain(2024) ] object detector to report Average Precision ( AP \mathrm{AP} , AP 50 \mathrm{AP}^{50} ) and Average Recall ( AR \mathrm{AR} ), while reporting the detector’s performance on ground-truth images as an empirical ceiling. Additionally, we assess global image quality and semantic alignment by computing CLIP score [ Hessel et al.(2021)Hessel, Holtzman, Forbes, Le Bras, and Choi ] , FID [ Heusel et al.(2017)Heusel, Ramsauer, Unterthiner, Nessler, and Hochreiter ] , and Inception Score (IS) [ Salimans et al.(2016)Salimans, Goodfellow, Zaremba, Cheung, Radford, and Chen ] .

We select FLUX.2-9B-base for our real-world experiments, as it achieved the strongest layout adherence among the architectures evaluated in Tab. 3 ( 81.5 81.5 mIoU 2 : 25 \mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} at μ = 1.0 \mu=1.0 ). To preserve the base model’s generative priors amidst complex real-world textures, we use a conservative learning rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} , which we found yields more stable convergence than the higher rates used for geometric primitives. For real-world images, we adopt the standard FLUX.2 sampling configuration (50 steps, 4.0 guidance). While more efficient settings sufficed in our synthetic study, these default parameters are better suited to resolving complex real-world textures. Bounding boxes are normalized to [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] , sequenced by appearance in the COCO annotations, and formatted as: [ x m ​ i ​ n , y m ​ i ​ n , x m ​ a ​ x , y m ​ a ​ x , category name ] [x_{min},y_{min},x_{max},y_{max},\text{category name}] .

blocks.en: Results. Table 4 demonstrates that spatial grounding via SNR distribution shifting ( μ = 3.0 \mu=3.0 ) robustly transfers from our controlled synthetic environment to complex real-world imagery. Despite using only text prompts and a lightweight 5-epoch fine-tuning on MS-COCO, our model achieves state-of-the-art layout adherence compared to specialized layout-to-image models (Table 5 ). Specifically, our Average Recall ( AR \mathrm{AR} ) of 65.2 65.2 significantly outperforms established models like GLIGEN ( 37.2 37.2 ), InstanceDiff ( 43.7 43.7 ), or Hybrid Layout ( 51.8 51.8 ), indicating that our model is remarkably effective at populating the canvas with all requested objects. Furthermore, our AP 50 \mathrm{AP}^{50} of 81.8 81.8 exceeds the YOLO-v11-x detector’s empirical ceiling on ground-truth COCO images ( 77.2 77.2 ). Since ground-truth represents a theoretical upper bound, we hypothesize this reflects known limitations in the COCO dataset itself (e.g., bounding box noise, motion blur, and greater occlusion and background clutter than in our generated images) that lower the detector’s measured ceiling on real-world images. Overall, this shows that our model’s spatial precision is effectively saturating the empirical ceiling. While FID ( 32.38 32.38 ) and CLIP scores ( 28.01 28.01 ) trail CreatiLayout [ Zhang et al.(2025)Zhang, Hong, Wang, Shao, Wu, Wu, and Jiang ] , which utilizes a more complex multi-stream architecture, our model achieves the highest Inception Score ( 30.32 30.32 ) among all compared methods, including CreatiLayout ( 30.26 30.26 ) and the ground-truth COCO images themselves ( 29.06 29.06 ), indicating that the rich generative priors of the FLUX.2-9B-base model are preserved during fine-tuning. To assess whether extended training yields further gains, we fine-tune FLUX.2-9B-base at μ = 3.0 \mu=3.0 for 10 epochs while evaluating after each epoch, which further improves layout adherence across all metrics ( AP \mathrm{AP} : 61.8 61.8 , AP 50 \mathrm{AP}^{50} : 84.7 84.7 , AR \mathrm{AR} : 68.8 68.8 ; Tab. 5 ). The complete epoch-ablation is reported in Appendix C . Qualitative results (Fig. 7 ) of the FLUX.2-9B-base model after 10 epochs of fine-tuning show faithful spatial generation across diverse scenes, challenging compositions, and densities (rows 1–3). Observed failure modes (row 4) include compositional artifacts (e.g., merged or duplicated anatomical features) and high-frequency imprecision (e.g., clock face details). Preliminary experiments applying layout-conditioned denoising only during the first 40–50% of steps improved fine-grained details with only a marginal AP \mathrm{AP} drop ( 1.5 1.5 – 5.1 5.1 points). While some compositional artifacts persist, also occasionally seen in the pre-trained FLUX.2-9B-base model prior to any fine-tuning (Appendix D ), unifying these dynamics into a single, potentially scaled, foundation model remains future work. Ultimately, these findings validate the insights from our synthetic benchmark: the lack of native spatial control in foundation flow-matching models is not an architectural limitation. By shifting the SNR distribution to prioritize global structural dependencies, a standard flow-matching transformer can parse spatial coordinates directly from the text stream and compete with specialized architectures.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we investigated the latent spatial grounding capabilities of flow-matching models, addressing the discrepancy between the rich spatial embeddings of modern vision-language encoders and the poor native layout adherence of the generative models that leverage them. Unlike the prevailing paradigm of introducing auxiliary structural adapters or complex inference-time optimizations, we show that precise spatial control can be ”unlocked” by shifting the timestep sampling distribution. Our systematic evaluation using a novel synthetic benchmark of geometric primitives allowed us to isolate the mechanics of spatial grounding from textural complexities. We identified the high-noise regime as a ”critical learning phase”, where the model is forced to internalize geometric constraints to establish global structure. By biasing the fine-tuning process toward these regimes, we enabled models to interpret 2D coordinates directly from text prompts with strong spatial accuracy. Furthermore, we demonstrated that these insights generalize to real-world imagery via the COCO dataset, achieving state-of-the-art layout adherence without any architectural modifications. The implications of our findings are twofold: first, they suggest that the perceived lack of spatial control in current models is not a limitation of architectural capacity. Second, our approach offers a highly efficient, architecture-agnostic path for enhancing spatial controllability, providing a recipe for integrating native layout adherence into future foundation models.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们调查了流动匹配模型的潜在空间定位能力,解决了现代视觉语言编码器丰富的空间嵌入与利用这些模型的基因模型本土布局守旧程度差之间的矛盾。 与普遍采用的采用辅助结构适配器或复杂的推论时间优化模式不同,我们表明,精确的空间控制可以通过改变时间步取样分布来“解锁”。 我们利用一种新的几何原始物合成基准进行系统评估,使我们能够将空间地面的力学与纹理复杂性隔离开来。 我们确定,高噪音制度是一个“关键学习阶段”,该模式被迫将几何制约因素内部化,以建立全球结构。 通过向这些制度倾斜微调过程,我们使模型能够从文字提示中直接从高度精确地解释2D坐标。 此外,我们证明,这些见解通过COCO数据集向现实世界的图像概括,实现最新版面的坚持,而无需对建筑进行任何修改。 我们的调查结果具有双重影响:第一,它们表明,目前模型中被认为缺乏空间控制并不是建筑能力的限制。 第二,我们的方法为加强空间可控性提供了高效、结构不可知的途径,为将本地布局的坚持性纳入未来的基础模式提供了方法。

blocks.en: Limitations and future work. While our approach provides a lightweight and architecture-agnostic path to spatial grounding, it reveals a trade-off: a strong bias toward high-noise regimes during fine-tuning, while essential for layout adherence, can compromise high-frequency textural synthesis. This suggests that the global structural alignment facilitated by high-noise training may compete with local generative refinement required for high-fidelity synthesis. Future research should investigate multi-stage or scheduled sampling distributions that transition from a high-noise bias (to lock in grounding) to a more uniform distribution (to recover textural quality). Furthermore, exploring Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) [ Liu et al.(2026c)Liu, Liu, Liang, Yuan, Liu, Zheng, Wu, Wang, Xia, Wang, et al. ] or other reinforcement learning techniques [ Liu et al.(2026b)Liu, Liu, Liang, Li, Liu, Wang, Wan, Zhang, and Ouyang ] presents a promising avenue for aligning model outputs with both layout constraints and human-perceived image quality.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 虽然我们的方法提供了轻量级和结构不可知的空间地面路径,但它揭示了一种取舍:在微调期间对高噪声系统的强烈偏向,虽然对布局的坚持至关重要,但会损害高频的纹理合成。 这表明,通过高噪音培训促进的全球结构调整可能与高可靠性合成所需的当地基因改良相竞争。 未来的研究应当调查多阶段或计划取样分布,这种分布从高噪音偏差(锁定地面)过渡到更统一的分布(恢复纹理质量)。 此外,探索直接优化优惠(DPO)[刘等人(2026c)Liu, 刘 梁iang 元,刘, 郑 吴,王,夏, Wang, et al.)或其他强化学习技术[刘等人(2026b) Liu, 刘 梁iang 丽 刘 王爷 阿远 张,欧阳)为将模型输出与布局限制和人心所见的图像质量相结合提供了一个很有希望的途径.

blocks.zh: 图11 尺度和密度依赖的布局坚持度. 基因模型(蓝色)饱和VAE的能力(gray). 虽然小物体的本地化难度较大,但场景密度之间性能稳定,近乎恒定的中位mIoU 2 : 25\mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25},为n ∈ [3, 10] n\ in [3, 10].

blocks.en: Object Scale. The relationship between object scale and layout adherence is illustrated in Fig. 11 (left). We observe a positive correlation between object size and spatial accuracy. As rectangle area increases, the model’s mIoU 2 : 25 \mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} consistently improves. For Large and Huge objects, the model achieves near-optimal spatial fidelity, with median mIoU 2 : 25 \mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} ranging from 0.85 to 0.95. While performance remains robust for Medium objects, we note an increase in variance, with the lower bound of the distribution dropping to 0.60. The model’s primary failure modes occur at smaller scales, where Tiny objects drop to a median mIoU 2 : 25 \mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} of approximately 0.41. Crucially, as shown in Fig. 11 , our model’s median performance closely tracks the VAE reconstruction baseline across all size categories, indicating that the model effectively approaches the average spatial capacity of the underlying latent representation. However, we note a slight divergence in the upper quartiles (75th percentile) for Tiny and Small objects, where the VAE baseline maintains a higher performance ceiling. This suggests that while our model accurately predicts the expected location of Small objects, it does not yet fully capture the extreme precision occasionally preserved by the VAE reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 对象缩放 。 图11(左)说明了物体尺度和布局坚持性之间的关系。 我们观测到物体大小和空间精确度之间的正相关关系。 随着矩形面积的增加,该模型的mIoU 2 : 25\mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25}持续改善. 对于大型和大型物体,模型实现了近乎最佳的空间忠诚,中间位数mIoU 2 : 25\mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25}从0.85到0.95不等. 虽然中等对象的性能仍然强劲,但我们注意到差异增加,分配的下限下降到0.60。 该模型的主要故障模式发生在较小的尺度上,其中小对象下降至中位mIoU 2 : 25\mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25},约为0.41. 关键是,如图11所示,我们的模型的中位性能密切跟踪了所有大小类别的VAE重建基线,表明模型有效地接近了潜在存在的平均空间能力。 然而,我们注意到,小微物体和小微物体的上四分位数(第75百分位数)略有差异,而VAE基线维持较高的性能上限。 这表明,虽然我们的模型准确地预测了小物体的预期位置,但它尚未完全捕捉到偶尔被VAE重建所保存的极端精度.

blocks.en: Object Density. We further analyze the impact of object density on layout adherence in Fig. 11 (right). Counter-intuitively, the model exhibits its highest variance when few rectangles are present ( n = 1 , 2 n=1,2 ), where the mIoU 2 : 25 \mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} distribution is broadest. Our investigation reveals that this is primarily driven by the object size sensitivity discussed previously. Performance in single-object images is highly dependent on whether that specific object is Tiny or Huge . As the number of objects increases, the statistics stabilize, with the median mIoU 2 : 25 \mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25} remaining remarkably constant up to n = 10 n=10 . This suggests that the model is robust to scene complexity and effectively maintains layout adherence in crowded environments, consistently approaching the VAE reconstruction median regardless of object count.
blocks.zh: 对象密度。 我们进一步分析图11(右)中物体密度对布局坚持性的影响。 反直觉上,模型在很少出现矩形(n=1,2n=1,2)时显示出其最高差异,其中mIoU 2 : 25\mathrm{mIoU}_{2:25}分布最广. 我们的调查显示,这主要受前述物体大小敏感性的驱动。 单对象图像中的性能高度依赖于该特定对象是小物体还是大物体 。 随着对象数量的增加,统计稳定,中间位数 mIoU 2 : 25\ mathrm{ mIoU 2: 25} 保持显著的恒定, 最高为 n = 10 n = 10 。 这表明该模型在拥挤的环境下,能强大地呈现复杂性并有效保持布局的坚持性,始终接近VAE重建中位数而不管物体计数.

blocks.en: Appendix C Extended Fine-Tuning on Real-World Images
blocks.zh: 附录C 真实世界图像的精细提示

blocks.en: To assess whether layout adherence continues to improve beyond the 5-epoch budget used in our μ \mu -ablation (Tab. 4 ), we fine-tune FLUX.2-9B-base at μ = 3.0 \mu=3.0 for 10 epochs, evaluating after each. Full epoch-by-epoch results are shown in Tab. 6 . The 10-epoch endpoint is also reported in Tab. 5 . Note that the 5-epoch checkpoint comes from this separate extended run and therefore slightly differs from the μ \mu -ablation’s 5-epoch result (Tab. 4 , Tab. 5 ) due to training variance. Average Precision (AP) and Average Recall (AR) improve continuously across all 10 epochs, with AP 50 peaking at epoch 9, suggesting diminishing returns beyond this point. AP and AP 50 exceed ground-truth COCO values after 10 epochs (see Sec. 5 for possible explanations), while AR approaches ground-truth. Image quality metrics vary more: CLIP peaks at epoch 7, remaining fairly stable between epochs 3–8 before declining slightly. The Inception Score fluctuates more but is generally highest from epoch 5 onward. FID, while also fluctuating, shows a general improving trend with extended training.

blocks.en: Appendix D Compositional Failures in Pre-Trained Model
blocks.zh: 附录D 培训前模式的失败

blocks.en: As noted in Sec. 5 , compositional artifacts (e.g., merged or duplicated anatomical features) occasionally occur in generated images of our fine-tuned FLUX.2-9B-base model (Fig. 7 ). However, as can be seen in Fig. 12 and Fig. 13 , such failure modes also occur in images generated using the pre-trained FLUX.2-9B-base model prior to any fine-tuning. The images were generated using the standard FLUX.2 sampling configuration (same as in Sec. 5 ), demonstrating that compositional failures such as merged elephant heads (Fig. 7 , row 4) are already present in the base model rather than being introduced by our fine-tuning procedure. Each figure shows 8 samples (random integer seeds) for the fixed prompt given in the figure title, generated at 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution with a guidance scale of 4.0 and 50 inference steps.
blocks.zh: 如第5节所述,组装文物(如合并或重复解剖特征)偶尔出现在我们微调的FLUX.2-9B基模型(图7)的生成图像中。 然而,如图12和图13所示,在任何微调之前,这种故障模式也发生在使用预先训练的FLUX.2-9B基模型生成的图像中. 图像是使用标准的FLUX.2采样配置(与第5章相同)生成的,表明组合大象头(图7,第4行)等组成故障已经存在于基模中,而不是通过我们的微调程序引入. 每个图都显示8个样本(随机整数种子),用于图题中给出的固定提示,生成时间为512×512 512\times 512分辨率,指导尺度为4.0和50推论步骤.
